evidence.detail: Archetype routes use numeric id: '/archetypes/<archetype_id>/' — no slug-based canonical URL
Card routes accept raw path (mixed-case, %20-encoded) with no canonical redirect to lowercase-hyphenated form
No canonical meta tags or 301 redirects for URL normalization
Existing redirects handle seasons/0 and discord but not card/archetype URL canonicalization

triage.notes: Author's last comment explicitly moves this to backlog: 'choosing backlog as that's the middle ground.' Completing it requires: slug generation for archetypes/cards, 301 redirect middleware, split-card URL handling, and rel=canonical meta tags — multiple interconnected changes across routing, templates, and URL generation.
